evidence.Medial Meniscus: Diffuse complex degenerative tear of the medial meniscus, with maceration and complete radial tear at the posterior horn-posterior root junction.
evidence.Medial OA: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with confluent regions of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with areas of high-grade fissuring at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.
evidence.PF OA: Confluent full-thickness articular cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet and lateral trochlea.
evidence.Baker's: Small leaking Baker's cyst with internal calcific body.
evidence.Fracture: Small subchondral insufficiency fracture at the medial tibial plateau near the medial joint line
